title: Document Holds for a Lapsed Vehicle Registration on Wayfare Driver Agreements: Desk Guidance
content:
**Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing.** This desk guidance covers the document hold that follows when the vehicle registration on file for a Wayfare driver agreement has expired.

## Rule

The vehicle registration on file is the latest vehicle registration upload on the standing record; once its expiry date has passed, the agreement goes on hold for an expired document with its hold start date set to that expiry date plus the registration grace days, and the hold is placed as soon as that start date has arrived. The registration grace days are the calendar days after the lapsed registration's expiry date on which the document hold for it begins.

The hold is a support action on an active agreement; it does not wait for a request from the driver.

## When the grace days are fixed

The registration grace days are fixed only after the standing record carries the quality warning owed for every rating review that found the cancellation rate above the level's threshold.

Stated the same way round: while a rating review on the standing record found the cancellation rate above the level's threshold and the quality warning owed for it is not on the standing record, the registration grace days are not yet fixed.

## Tool

The hold is placed with the agent tool `place_registration_hold_154e4b50`. It is a hidden tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

- `driver_agreement_id`: the reference number of the driver services agreement being put on hold, as returned by the driver agreement lookup.
- `registration_expiry_date`: the expiry date of the lapsed vehicle registration, copied exactly as the standing record lookup shows it on the latest registration upload, written `YYYY-MM-DD` (a calendar date, no time of day).
- `grace_days`: the number of calendar days after that expiry date on which the hold begins, a whole number (integer, no decimals, no unit text).

One call moves the agreement from active to on hold, records the hold reason `document_expired` (an expired document), and sets the hold start date to the registration's expiry date advanced by `grace_days` calendar days. The driver cannot go online while the hold is in force.

## Receipt

A dictionary receipt with `driver_agreement_id`, `status` (`on_hold` on success), `hold_reason` (`document_expired`) and `hold_started_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, the hold start date recorded). A receipt with status `on_hold` means the hold is in force. The tool's contract defines no other outcome.

Hypothetical illustration: a `registration_expiry_date` of `2026-04-30` with `grace_days` of `4` gives a `hold_started_date` of `2026-05-04`.
